program = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [[8 for _ in row] for row in grid]

    for r, c in cells:
        value = grid[r][c]
        new_value = b if value == a else a
        new_c = c + shift if r <= middle else c
        out[r][new_c] = new_value
    return out
'''
